schema.description:
ID of the configuration. Allowed characters include uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), colons (:), asterisks (*), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). When the ID prefix is one of the following values, ACM automatically uses the KMS service to encrypt and store this configuration:

- Prefix `cipher-`: Invokes the KMS service to encrypt and decrypt the configuration. The data size for encryption and decryption must not exceed 4 KB and can be up to 6 KB at maximum. Special characters such as ampersand (&) may cause decryption errors. This option is not recommended.

- Prefix `cipher-kms-aes-128-`: Uses the KMS envelope encryption and decryption method. The configuration content can exceed 6 KB and can be up to 100 KB at maximum. The plaintext data of the configuration is not transmitted to the KMS system, providing higher security. This option is recommended.
Name of the application to which the configuration belongs
Tags of the configuration. If multiple tags exist, separate them with commas (,).

Format of the configuration content. Valid values are as follows:

- text

- json

- xml

- yaml

- text/html

- properties
